svg.title: Chatham XI: interpretive SVG study
svg.desc: Two joined monochrome panels forming an inverted L. Approximate geometry, standardized vivid screen palette, transparent background. Panel dimensions come from the museum record; image checked for orientation.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://buffaloakg.org/artworks/k197212-chatham-xi-blue-yellow; reviewed 2026-10-26; interpretive reconstruction, not a facsimile.
